// Test de acceptanță scris de Ifrim Agent Hub din criteriile proprietarului (misiunea mis_rehearsal_s25, spec v1 75e16e814199).
// Protejat după review: se repară implementarea, nu testul. Nu îl modifica manual.
import test from "node:test";
import assert from "node:assert/strict";
import path from "node:path";
import os from "node:os";
import fs from "node:fs";
import * as sqlite from "node:sqlite";
import http from "node:http";
const load = async (rel) => { try { return await import(new URL(rel, import.meta.url)); } catch (e) { assert.fail(`HUB_LOAD ${rel}: ${e?.code || e?.name || "eroare"}`); } };
const need = (m, name) => { if (typeof m[name] === "function") return m[name]; assert.fail(`HUB_SETUP export ${name}: ${name in m ? typeof m[name] : "lipsește"}`); };
const setup = async (label, fn) => { try { return await fn(); } catch (e) { assert.fail(`HUB_SETUP ${label}: ${e?.code || e?.name || "eroare"}`); } };
// json-exposure v1 sha256 984e7cf2876d: checks only the given response; not a general personal-data certification.
function exposes(text, config) {
  const fail = (why) => assert.fail(`HUB_SETUP exposes: ${why}`);
  if (typeof text !== "string") fail("corpul răspunsului nu este text");
  const { keys, values } = config || {};
  if (!Array.isArray(keys) || !Array.isArray(values)) fail("cheile și valorile trebuie să fie liste");
  if (!keys.length || !values.length) fail("listele de chei și valori nu pot fi goale");
  if ([...keys].some((k) => typeof k !== "string" || !k.trim())) fail("o cheie nu este text nevid");
  if ([...values].some((v) => typeof v !== "string" || v.trim().length < 3)) fail("o valoare nu este text cu minimum trei caractere");
  let data; try { data = JSON.parse(text); } catch { fail("corpul răspunsului nu este JSON valid"); }
  const found = [], add = (p, kind, i) => { if (found.length < 50) found.push(`${p}: ${kind}${i === undefined ? "" : `, valoarea #${i + 1}`}`); };
  const contains = (s, v) => s.includes(v) || s.includes(v.trim());
  const matches = (s, p, kind) => values.forEach((v, i) => { if (contains(s, v)) add(p, kind, i); });
  const walk = (v, p) => { if (typeof v === "string" || typeof v === "number") matches(String(v), p, "valoare"); else if (v && typeof v === "object") { for (const [i, [k, child]] of Object.entries(v).entries()) { const segment = Array.isArray(v) ? `[${i}]` : values.some((s) => contains(k, s)) || k.length > 40 ? "[*]" : `[${JSON.stringify(k)}]`; const next = `${p.length > 120 ? "$.." : p}${segment}`; if (keys.includes(k)) add(next, "cheie"); matches(k, next, "cheie-valoare"); walk(child, next); } } };
  try { walk(data, "$"); } catch { fail("răspunsul nu poate fi parcurs în siguranță"); }
  return found;
}
// ---- corpul testului ----
const pad2 = (n) => String(n).padStart(2, "0");
const toDateKey = (d) => `${d.getFullYear()}-${pad2(d.getMonth() + 1)}-${pad2(d.getDate())}`;
const TEST_DAY = (() => {
  const [y, mo, d] = toDateKey(new Date()).split("-").map(Number);
  return toDateKey(new Date(y, mo - 1, d + 1, 12));
})();

function doRequest(opts, bodyStr) {
  return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    const req = http.request(opts, (res) => {
      const chunks = [];
      res.on("data", (c) => chunks.push(c));
      res.on("end", () => resolve({ status: res.statusCode, body: Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8") }));
    });
    req.on("error", reject);
    if (bodyStr !== undefined) req.write(bodyStr);
    req.end();
  });
}

function postJson(port, data) {
  const body = JSON.stringify(data);
  return doRequest({
    hostname: "127.0.0.1", port, path: "/api/bookings", method: "POST",
    headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json", "Content-Length": Buffer.byteLength(body) },
  }, body);
}

function getList(port, extra) {
  const qs = extra ? `?date=${TEST_DAY}&${extra}` : `?date=${TEST_DAY}`;
  return doRequest({ hostname: "127.0.0.1", port, path: `/api/bookings${qs}`, method: "GET", headers: {} });
}

test("AC-1: lista publică a zilei nu conține câmpul phone și valorile telefonului", async () => {
  const m = await load("../../src/server-app.js");
  const startServer = need(m, "startServer");
  const tmpDir = await setup("tmpdir", () => fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "s25-ac1-")));
  const dbPath = path.join(tmpDir, "test.db");
  const phoneA = "0711 100 200";
  const phoneB = "0722 300 400";

  const s1 = await setup("srv1", () => startServer({ port: 0, dbPath, seed: false }));
  const r1 = await setup("post1", () => postJson(s1.port, {
    serviceId: "spalare-exterior", start: `${TEST_DAY}T09:00`,
    name: "Client Existent", vehicle: "Dacia Test", phone: phoneA,
  }));
  await setup("close1", () => s1.close());
  const idA = await setup("idA", () => {
    if (r1.status !== 201) throw new Error(`201 expected, got ${r1.status}: ${r1.body}`);
    return JSON.parse(r1.body).booking.id;
  });

  const s2 = await setup("srv2", () => startServer({ port: 0, dbPath, seed: false }));
  try {
    const r2 = await setup("post2", () => postJson(s2.port, {
      serviceId: "spalare-exterior", start: `${TEST_DAY}T09:30`,
      name: "Client Nou", vehicle: "Dacia Nou", phone: phoneB,
    }));
    const idB = await setup("idB", () => {
      if (r2.status !== 201) throw new Error(`201 expected, got ${r2.status}: ${r2.body}`);
      return JSON.parse(r2.body).booking.id;
    });

    const tdb = await setup("tdb", () => new sqlite.DatabaseSync(dbPath));
    const rowA = tdb.prepare("SELECT id, day, phone FROM bookings WHERE id = ?").get(idA);
    const rowB = tdb.prepare("SELECT id, day, phone FROM bookings WHERE id = ?").get(idB);
    tdb.close();

    assert.ok(rowA, "înregistrarea existentă există în BD");
    assert.ok(rowB, "înregistrarea nouă există în BD");
    assert.equal(rowA.day, TEST_DAY, "ziua înregistrării existente");
    assert.equal(rowB.day, TEST_DAY, "ziua înregistrării noi");

    const listRes = await getList(s2.port, "");
    assert.equal(listRes.status, 200, "lista publică returnează 200");

    const listData = JSON.parse(listRes.body);
    const bIds = listData.bookings.map((b) => b.id);
    assert.ok(bIds.includes(idA), "id-ul existent apare în lista publică");
    assert.ok(bIds.includes(idB), "id-ul nou apare în lista publică");

    assert.deepEqual(
      exposes(listRes.body, { keys: ["phone"], values: [rowA.phone, rowB.phone] }),
      [],
      "lista publică nu expune telefonul"
    );
  } finally {
    await s2.close();
  }
});

test("AC-2: parametrii anonimi nu expun telefonul în lista publică", async () => {
  const m = await load("../../src/server-app.js");
  const startServer = need(m, "startServer");
  const tmpDir = await setup("tmpdir", () => fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "s25-ac2-")));
  const dbPath = path.join(tmpDir, "test.db");
  const phoneC = "0733 500 600";
  const phoneD = "0744 700 800";

  const s1 = await setup("srv1", () => startServer({ port: 0, dbPath, seed: false }));
  const r1 = await setup("post1", () => postJson(s1.port, {
    serviceId: "spalare-exterior", start: `${TEST_DAY}T09:00`,
    name: "Existent Doi", vehicle: "BMW Test", phone: phoneC,
  }));
  await setup("close1", () => s1.close());
  const idC = await setup("idC", () => {
    if (r1.status !== 201) throw new Error(`201 expected, got ${r1.status}: ${r1.body}`);
    return JSON.parse(r1.body).booking.id;
  });

  const s2 = await setup("srv2", () => startServer({ port: 0, dbPath, seed: false }));
  try {
    const r2 = await setup("post2", () => postJson(s2.port, {
      serviceId: "spalare-exterior", start: `${TEST_DAY}T09:30`,
      name: "Nou Doi", vehicle: "Audi Test", phone: phoneD,
    }));
    const idD = await setup("idD", () => {
      if (r2.status !== 201) throw new Error(`201 expected, got ${r2.status}: ${r2.body}`);
      return JSON.parse(r2.body).booking.id;
    });

    const tdb = await setup("tdb", () => new sqlite.DatabaseSync(dbPath));
    const rowC = tdb.prepare("SELECT id, day, phone FROM bookings WHERE id = ?").get(idC);
    const rowD = tdb.prepare("SELECT id, day, phone FROM bookings WHERE id = ?").get(idD);
    tdb.close();

    assert.ok(rowC, "înregistrarea existentă există în BD");
    assert.ok(rowD, "înregistrarea nouă există în BD");
    assert.equal(rowC.day, TEST_DAY, "ziua înregistrării existente");
    assert.equal(rowD.day, TEST_DAY, "ziua înregistrării noi");

    for (const p of ["includePhone=1", "phone=1", "fields=phone", "debug=1", "all=1"]) {
      const res = await getList(s2.port, p);
      assert.equal(res.status, 200, `lista cu ${p} returnează 200`);
      const pData = JSON.parse(res.body);
      const pIds = pData.bookings.map((b) => b.id);
      assert.ok(pIds.includes(idC), `id-ul existent apare în lista cu ${p}`);
      assert.ok(pIds.includes(idD), `id-ul nou apare în lista cu ${p}`);
      assert.deepEqual(
        exposes(res.body, { keys: ["phone"], values: [rowC.phone, rowD.phone] }),
        [],
        `lista cu ${p} nu expune telefonul`
      );
    }
  } finally {
    await s2.close();
  }
});

test("AC-3 control: telefon obligatoriu refuzat când lipsește, e gol sau are doar spații", async () => {
  const m = await load("../../src/server-app.js");
  const startServer = need(m, "startServer");
  const tmpDir = await setup("tmpdir", () => fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "s25-ac3-")));
  const dbPath = path.join(tmpDir, "test.db");
  const srv = await setup("srv", () => startServer({ port: 0, dbPath, seed: false }));
  try {
    const base = { serviceId: "spalare-exterior", start: `${TEST_DAY}T09:00`, name: "Client Test", vehicle: "Dacia Test" };

    const rMissing = await postJson(srv.port, base);
    assert.equal(rMissing.status, 400, "refuzat când phone lipsește");
    assert.ok(JSON.parse(rMissing.body).errors.phone, "eroare la câmpul phone când lipsește");
    const tdb1 = new sqlite.DatabaseSync(dbPath);
    const cnt1 = tdb1.prepare("SELECT count(*) as n FROM bookings WHERE day = ?").get(TEST_DAY);
    tdb1.close();
    assert.equal(cnt1.n, 0, "nicio programare salvată după refuzul fără phone");

    const rEmpty = await postJson(srv.port, { ...base, phone: "" });
    assert.equal(rEmpty.status, 400, "refuzat când phone e șir gol");
    assert.ok(JSON.parse(rEmpty.body).errors.phone, "eroare la câmpul phone când e gol");
    const tdb2 = new sqlite.DatabaseSync(dbPath);
    const cnt2 = tdb2.prepare("SELECT count(*) as n FROM bookings WHERE day = ?").get(TEST_DAY);
    tdb2.close();
    assert.equal(cnt2.n, 0, "nicio programare salvată după refuzul phone gol");

    const rSpaces = await postJson(srv.port, { ...base, phone: "   " });
    assert.equal(rSpaces.status, 400, "refuzat când phone are doar spații");
    assert.ok(JSON.parse(rSpaces.body).errors.phone, "eroare la câmpul phone când are doar spații");
    const tdb3 = new sqlite.DatabaseSync(dbPath);
    const cnt3 = tdb3.prepare("SELECT count(*) as n FROM bookings WHERE day = ?").get(TEST_DAY);
    tdb3.close();
    assert.equal(cnt3.n, 0, "nicio programare salvată după refuzul phone cu spații");
  } finally {
    await srv.close();
  }
});

test("AC-4 control: telefonul trimis se păstrează exact în stocarea internă", async () => {
  const m = await load("../../src/server-app.js");
  const startServer = need(m, "startServer");
  const tmpDir = await setup("tmpdir", () => fs.mkdtempSync(path.join(os.tmpdir(), "s25-ac4-")));
  const dbPath = path.join(tmpDir, "test.db");
  const srv = await setup("srv", () => startServer({ port: 0, dbPath, seed: false }));
  try {
    const sentPhone = "0799 888 777";
    const r = await postJson(srv.port, {
      serviceId: "spalare-exterior", start: `${TEST_DAY}T09:00`,
      name: "Client Storage", vehicle: "Dacia Storage", phone: sentPhone,
    });
    assert.equal(r.status, 201, "programarea validă e acceptată");
    const bookingId = JSON.parse(r.body).booking.id;
    const tdb = new sqlite.DatabaseSync(dbPath);
    const row = tdb.prepare("SELECT phone FROM bookings WHERE id = ?").get(bookingId);
    tdb.close();
    assert.ok(row, "înregistrarea există în BD");
    assert.equal(row.phone, sentPhone, "telefonul din BD corespunde exact cu cel trimis");
  } finally {
    await srv.close();
  }
});

test("AC-5 control: programare validă cu telefon e acceptată de server", async () => {
  const m = await load("../../src/server-app.js");
  const startServer = need(m, "startServer");
  const srv = await setup("srv", () => startServer({ port: 0, dbPath: ":memory:", seed: false }));
  try {
    const r = await postJson(srv.port, {
      serviceId: "spalare-exterior", start: `${TEST_DAY}T09:00`,
      name: "Client Valid", vehicle: "Dacia Valid", phone: "0700 111 999",
    });
    assert.equal(r.status, 201, "programare validă cu telefon e acceptată cu status 201");
    const body = JSON.parse(r.body);
    assert.ok(body.booking && body.booking.id, "răspunsul conține id-ul programării");
  } finally {
    await srv.close();
  }
});
